newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear Tire in $17 mln pact with Sandia.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear Tire in $17 mln pact with Sandia.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co and the U.S. Department of Energy's Sandia National Laboratories said Thursday they signed a $17 million technology-sharing pact to develop more efficient manufacturing processes.
In a joint statement, Goodyear said it will fund about 90 percent of the joint work, $7 million directly and $8 million to fund facilities and labor costs for its own researchers.
The pact is the fifth cooperative research and development agreement between Goodyear and Sandia since 1993, the statement added.
Sandia is a multi-program national Department of Energy laboratory operated by a unit of Lockheed Martin Corp.
